## Summary
Implement auto-save that upserts the student's answer to session_answers on every answer selection, with a hash chain audit trail for FERPA compliance.

## User story
As a student taking an exam, I want my answer selections to be saved immediately, so that if my browser crashes or I lose connectivity I never lose more than the current unsaved answer.

## Why this matters
C01 finding: if answers are only saved on submit, a browser crash loses the entire exam. This is unacceptable for LCME-accredited high-stakes assessments. Every single answer selection must trigger an upsert. The hash chain ensures FERPA-compliant tamper detection for grade disputes.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] useAutoSave hook triggers an API call on EVERY answer selection (not debounced)
- [ ] API route upserts session_answers (insert if new, update if existing for same item)
- [ ] Upsert includes: session_id, session_item_id, selected_option_id, saved_at timestamp
- [ ] Hash chain: each save includes prev_hash + SHA-256(prev_hash + answer + timestamp)
- [ ] Optimistic UI: answer appears selected immediately, background save follows
- [ ] Failed saves are retried with exponential backoff (3 attempts max)
- [ ] After 3 failures, a persistent "save failed" banner appears
- [ ] Inngest event journey/attempt.submitted fires on each successful save
- [ ] session_answers has unique constraint on (session_id, session_item_id)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| C01 | Auto-save on EVERY answer selection — this IS the C01 fix |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Supabase-first — answers saved to Supabase, no Neo4j involved |
| Data Layer | createServerClient() in API route for upsert |
| Data Layer | createBrowserClient() in useAutoSave hook for optimistic UI |
| AP-17 | Single upsert per answer — no sequential multi-table inserts needed |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- session_answers table (mutable draft — updated on every selection)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.session_answers (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.exam_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  session_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.session_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  selected_option_id UUID,
  saved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  prev_hash TEXT,
  answer_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (session_id, session_item_id)
);

-- Index for fast lookups during exam
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_session_answers_session
  ON public.session_answers (session_id);

-- RLS: students can only upsert their own session answers
ALTER TABLE public.session_answers ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Students can upsert own session answers"
  ON public.session_answers FOR ALL
  USING (
    session_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.exam_sessions WHERE student_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- Audit log for hash chain
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.answer_audit_log (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  session_answer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.session_answers(id),
  selected_option_id UUID,
  saved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  prev_hash TEXT,
  answer_hash TEXT NOT NULL
);
```

## API contract
```
PUT /app/api/exams/[id]/answer
Headers: Cookie (student session)
Request: {
  session_id: string,
  session_item_id: string,
  selected_option_id: string,
  prev_hash: string | null
}
Response 200: { data: { answer_hash: string, saved_at: string }, error: null }
Response 400: { data: null, error: { code: 'INVALID_SESSION', message: 'Session expired or not found' } }
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }
Response 409: { data: null, error: { code: 'HASH_MISMATCH', message: 'Hash chain broken' } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/exam-delivery/hooks/useAutoSave.ts
'use client';
import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

export function useAutoSave(sessionId: string) {
  const lastHashRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const retryCountRef = useRef(0);

  const saveAnswer = useCallback(async (
    sessionItemId: string,
    selectedOptionId: string
  ) => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/exams/${sessionId}/answer`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          session_id: sessionId,
          session_item_id: sessionItemId,
          selected_option_id: selectedOptionId,
          prev_hash: lastHashRef.current,
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Save failed: ${res.status}`);

      const { data } = await res.json();
      lastHashRef.current = data.answer_hash;
      retryCountRef.current = 0;
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      retryCountRef.current++;
      if (retryCountRef.current < 3) {
        // Exponential backoff retry
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, retryCountRef.current) * 1000));
        return saveAnswer(sessionItemId, selectedOptionId);
      }
      return { success: false, error };
    }
  }, [sessionId]);

  return { saveAnswer, retryCount: retryCountRef };
}

// app/api/exams/[id]/answer/route.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import { createHash } from 'crypto';
import { inngest } from '@journey/inngest/client';

function computeHash(prevHash: string | null, optionId: string, timestamp: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256')
    .update(`${prevHash || 'genesis'}:${optionId}:${timestamp}`)
    .digest('hex');
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ C01 violation: Debounced save — BANNED
const debouncedSave = useDebouncedCallback(saveAnswer, 2000); // BANNED
// Every selection MUST trigger immediate save

// ✗ C01 violation: Save only on page change — BANNED
useEffect(() => { saveAnswers(); }, [currentIndex]); // BANNED
// Must save on selection, not navigation

// ✗ Missing hash chain — FERPA violation
await supabase.from('session_answers').upsert({
  session_id, session_item_id, selected_option_id
  // No answer_hash, no prev_hash — BANNED
});
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E07/E07-S05.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('PUT /api/exams/[id]/answer upserts answer and returns hash', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.put('/api/exams/test-session/answer', {
    data: {
      session_id: 'test-session-id',
      session_item_id: 'test-item-id',
      selected_option_id: 'option-a',
      prev_hash: null
    }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.answer_hash).toBeTruthy();
  expect(data.saved_at).toBeTruthy();
});

test('PUT /api/exams/[id]/answer updates existing answer (upsert)', async ({ request }) => {
  // First save
  const res1 = await request.put('/api/exams/test-session/answer', {
    data: {
      session_id: 'test-session-id',
      session_item_id: 'test-item-id',
      selected_option_id: 'option-a',
      prev_hash: null
    }
  });
  const { data: data1 } = await res1.json();

  // Second save (change answer)
  const res2 = await request.put('/api/exams/test-session/answer', {
    data: {
      session_id: 'test-session-id',
      session_item_id: 'test-item-id',
      selected_option_id: 'option-b',
      prev_hash: data1.answer_hash
    }
  });
  expect(res2.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data: data2 } = await res2.json();
  expect(data2.answer_hash).not.toBe(data1.answer_hash);
});

test('Negative: unauthenticated request returns 401', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.put('/api/exams/test-session/answer', {
    data: { session_id: 'x', session_item_id: 'x', selected_option_id: 'x', prev_hash: null }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.answer_audit_log CASCADE;`
2. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.session_answers CASCADE;`
3. No Neo4j changes to revert.
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
